title: The attestation statement `attavo attest` prints on a coherent chain (v7: `acts` is dropped -- the approval is the statement's own approval claim and the merge its subject in the store; `interventions` stays; v6: `interventions` and `acts` are read from the item's own commits between its first spec commit and its merge, each one classed exactly once by attavo/ledger.py::item_ledger -- sha is now required in both; v5: `cost` also prices, from the tenant's published rates, a record whose adapter reported none, and says so; v4: `time`, `cost` and `tokens` are the only accounting, summed over every attempt; v3 statements sealed earlier also carry cost_by_stage_usd, wall_clock_by_stage_s and tokens_by_stage, the final attempt of each stage)

interventions.description: Every operator row on the item other than approve and merge -- amend, launch, transport -- read from attavo/ledger.py::item_ledger's own rows between the item's first spec commit and its merge (issue #349): the row's class, its sha, the commit's own author name, and its committer time.

time.description: Every invocation of the item, summed by attest from its stage records' wall_clock_s: per stage and for the item, every attempt and not the final one alone. lead_s runs from the first approval record's `at` to the committer time of the commit the statement is computed at; waiting_s is lead_s minus invocation_s. A record with no wall_clock_s is named in not_read and its sums are partial, never smaller in silence.

cost.description: Every record's cost summed by attest: the item's total across stages and executors (ruled 2026-09-19), with a subtotal per stage and per adapter. A record's cost_usd is taken as the adapter reported it; a record that reported none, with numeric tokens and a model the tenant's manifest has a [cost.rates] entry for, is priced as tokens times that rate (ruled 2026-10-05: computed here, never written into a record). usd is reported_usd plus estimated_usd. A record neither reported nor priceable is named in not_read, naming the missing rate, and makes usd and the subtotals it belongs to partial: absent is never zero, and a partial total says so.

basis_by_stage.description: For each stage with an amount: reported (every amount the adapter's), estimated (every amount priced here) or mixed.

rates.description: The tenant's rates this statement priced a record by, per model, as the manifest carried them: empty when nothing was priced.

estimate_note.const: Estimated amounts are tokens times the tenant's published rates: a meter at API prices, not a bill.

tokens.description: Every record's tokens summed by attest: per stage and for the item, input and output over every attempt and not the final one alone. With `time` and `cost`, the statement's only accounting. A record with no tokens is named in not_read and makes the sums it belongs to partial: absent is never zero.
